title: Update an assigned entity roadmap without erasing proposal or assignment history
preconditions: Once public entity assignment exists, W owns proposed entity E and requires integration/review evidence; E has one proposal revision and W has an existing portable assignment. No required merge is integrated.

steps.action: Record exact implementation code evidence for E through its public entity operation, then query entity history and W assignment.
steps.expected_result: Entity roadmap exposes implemented evidence while original proposal and assignment history remain intact.

steps.action: Query W integration and review readiness with only E completed.
steps.expected_result: Required integration/review evidence is still missing and entity completion does not satisfy those requirements.

expected_result: Entity realization advances the roadmap while delivery obligations remain independent.
